title: Indicator polynomial on the sign cube
statement: For any positive integer $n$ and sign vectors $a,x\in\{ -1,1\}^n$, the polynomial $\prod_{i=1}^n(1+a_i x_i)/2$ equals $1$ when $x=a$ and $0$ otherwise.
